result.instructions: Tools for Breezy HR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which candidates have been in the interviewing stage for more than two weeks?"; "Give me a hiring summary for the Senior Engineer role: candidates per stage and recent applicants."; "Move the top candidate on the Product Manager role to the Offer stage and add a note that the offer was sent.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Breezy HR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run breezy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run breezy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run breezy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. breezy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: breezy_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the Breezy user that owns the token: name, email and username. Breezy API: GET /user.

tools.name: breezy_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies the token user belongs to, with their ids. Call this first to get the company_id for every other tool. Breezy API: GET /companies.

tools.name: breezy_list_pipelines
tools.title: List hiring pipelines
tools.description: List the company's hiring pipelines, keyed by name (for example default and default_pool), with their ordered stages. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/pipelines.

tools.name: breezy_get_pipeline_stages
tools.title: Get pipeline stages
tools.description: Return the ordered stages of one pipeline. Use a stage id with breezy_set_candidate_stage. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/pipeline/{pipelineId}.

tools.name: breezy_list_positions
tools.title: List positions
tools.description: List the company's positions (job openings). Archived positions are left out unless state is given. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/positions.

page.description: 1-based page number. Used only with page_size.

sort.description: Sort order the API accepts, for example updated.

tools.name: breezy_get_position
tools.title: Get a position
tools.description: Return one position in full: name, type, state, location, department, description, salary range, custom attributes and team members. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/position/{positionId}.

tools.name: breezy_get_position_summary
tools.title: Get position summary
tools.description: Return counts for one position's active candidates: per stage, top 5 sources, applications in the last 7 and 30 days, hired and disqualified totals. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/position/{positionId}/summary.

tools.name: breezy_set_position_state
tools.title: Change position state
tools.description: Set a position's lifecycle state to published, draft, archived or closed. Publishing or closing changes what the public sees. Breezy API: PUT /company/{id}/position/{positionId}/state.

tools.name: breezy_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates on a position
tools.description: List the candidates on one position: id, name, contact details, stage, source and score. Pass stage_id to limit to one stage. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/position/{positionId}/candidates.

stage_id.description: Only candidates in this pipeline stage (from breezy_get_pipeline_stages).

page.description: 1-based page number. Used only with page_size.

tools.name: breezy_get_candidate
tools.title: Get a candidate
tools.description: Return one candidate's full profile on a position: contact details, source, stage, resume link, education, work history, tags and score. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/position/{positionId}/candidate/{candidateId}.

tools.name: breezy_get_candidate_activity
tools.title: Get candidate activity
tools.description: Return a candidate's activity stream on a position, newest first: stage moves, notes, interviews and questionnaire events. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/position/{positionId}/candidate/{candidateId}/stream.

skip.description: How many activity items to skip, for paging.

tools.name: breezy_get_candidate_conversation
tools.title: Get candidate messages
tools.description: Return the messages sent to and from one candidate, newest first, with interview-time proposals. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/position/{positionId}/candidate/{candidateId}/conversation.

tools.name: breezy_search_candidates
tools.title: Search candidates
tools.description: Search every candidate in the company by name, text or email address. Results are per position, so one person can appear more than once. Breezy API: POST /company/{id}/candidates/search.

match.description: How the text must match. Default prefix.

tools.name: breezy_set_candidate_stage
tools.title: Move a candidate to a stage
tools.description: Move one candidate to another stage of the position's pipeline. Moving into a Hired-type stage marks the candidate hired, and some stages start integrations. Get stage ids from breezy_get_pipeline_stages. Breezy API: PUT /company/{id}/position/{positionId}/candidate/{candidateId}/stage.

stage_id.description: Target stage id from the position's pipeline.

annotations.title: Move a candidate to a stage

tools.name: breezy_add_candidate_note
tools.title: Add an internal note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a candidate's activity stream. The note is visible to the hiring team only, never to the candidate. Breezy API: POST /company/{id}/position/{positionId}/candidate/{candidateId}/stream.

tools.name: breezy_get_report
tools.title: Get a hiring report
tools.description: Return a Breezy report with the same numbers as the Reports page. Company reports need a company admin; a position report needs report access on that position. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/reports/{reportType}.

position_id.description: Limit the report to one position.

pipeline_id.description: Limit the report to one pipeline.

start_date.description: Start date for customRange, as yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: End date for customRange, as yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: breezy_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List open tasks across the company, or filter by position, candidate or assignee. assigned_to=me lists the token user's own tasks. Breezy API: GET /company/{id}/tasks.

type.description: Task type, for example taskCandidateScorecard for scorecard requests.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Breezy HR
prompts.description: What you can do with Breezy HR here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_candidates_in_one_stage
prompts.title: Review candidates in one stage
prompts.description: List the candidates of a position, filtered by stage, then read one profile with its resume link and score.

prompts.name: check_how_a_role_is_doing
prompts.title: Check how a role is doing
prompts.description: Read a position summary with counts per stage, top sources and applications in the last 7 and 30 days.

prompts.name: find_a_candidate_across_all_roles
prompts.title: Find a candidate across all roles
prompts.description: Search every candidate in the company by name, text or email, then read the activity of one candidate.

prompts.name: move_a_candidate_to_another_stage
prompts.title: Move a candidate to another stage
prompts.description: Read the stages of a pipeline, then move one candidate to a stage. A Hired-type stage marks the candidate as hired.

prompts.name: add_an_internal_note_to_a_candidate
prompts.title: Add an internal note to a candidate
prompts.description: Add a note to the activity of a candidate. Only the hiring team sees it, and the candidate never does.

prompts.name: read_a_hiring_report
prompts.title: Read a hiring report
prompts.description: Read a hiring report with the same numbers as the Reports page. Company reports need a company admin.
